complete_examples.text: In this section, the evaluation index for the Z vibration level in Railway standards of the People’s Republic of China37 is used to assess the near-field and far-field ground vibration.

The Z vibration level distribution illustrated in Fig. 14 indicates that in the near-field soil (soil point 1), vibrations across all frequencies (4–90 Hz) contribute to the overall vibration, whereas in the far-field soil (soil points 2–4), vibrations are predominantly within the 12–60Hz range.
